title: TOPS (BSC) NEM-class burn-from-pair + sync() gate resolved: unprivileged-reachable but structurally self-defeating ($0); the 2026-10-23 state barriers (buyEnabled=false, closed price gate) have since re-opened and the verdict is re-confirmed at HEAD
closed_reasons: STRUCTURAL (load-bearing, fork-proven at HEAD): the recycle burn removes only <= sellAmount/10 from the pair while the 20% sell fee is re-swapped INTO the same pair by _swapTokenForCake(), so reserve1 never collapses. HEAD test_R3b: a 100000 TOPS sell fires TokensRecycled (burn 10000 TOPS) yet d(reserve1) = +90000 TOPS (reserve1 GROWS)

Size closes the gate: a 20000 USDT buy raises spot >2% over priceTracker.currentPrice, so the following sell emits ZERO recycle events (test_R3). Only a pre-existing holder (or a <2%-of-pool buy) can fire the recycle, capping the burn at a tiny fraction
Cost >= reward: token cost to drain reserve1 ~= $95910 vs max reward reserve0 = $95862 (test_R6); a 20000 USDT buy->sell round trip loses -9781 USDT (-48.9%) (test_R4)

STATE CHANGED vs the 2026-10-23 analysis (block 129280478): buyEnabled false->true and the price gate CLOSED->OPEN at HEAD (129586140). The original 'no outsider entry' and 'closed price gate' reasons no longer hold; the structural reason above is the correct and sufficient one
Only unopposed burn is the amount<10000 rounding hole (fee = floor(amount/1e4)*rate = 0), capped at 999 wei/call -> ~10:1 loss and 1.56e19 calls for 2% of reserve1
LP exit is no longer blocked: router.removeLiquidity now SUCCEEDS at HEAD (it reverted 'not allow to remove' while buyEnabled=false on 2026-10-23) - the 2026-10-23 'freeze' exposure is gone

one_liner: External unprivileged attacker can extract $0.00 live from the TOPS NEM-class candidate: the burn-from-pair + sync() sell hook is unprivileged-reachable (and the 2026-10-23 state barriers - buyEnabled=false and a closed price gate - have since re-opened), but it is structurally self-defeating because the 20% sell fee is re-swapped into the same pair, so reserve1 grows on every sell (100k TOPS sell -> burn 10k, d(reserve1)=+90k); a 20k USDT round trip loses 48.9% and the token cost to drain reserve1 ($95,910) exceeds the reward ($95,862). 18/18 fork tests.
